confidence.reason_vi: Firewall Manager là dịch vụ được thiết kế để áp rule group WAF tập trung cho toàn organization và tự áp dụng cho resource mới; các phương án khác không đảm bảo hoặc tốn công hơn. Giảm xuống medium vì cụm 'all accounts and Regions' không chính xác: policy Firewall Manager theo từng Region.
open_issues: Firewall Manager yêu cầu tạo policy riêng cho mỗi Region; phương án C mô tả scope 'all Regions' trong một policy là không chính xác về kỹ thuật.
Member account phải có subscription rule group Marketplace thì Firewall Manager mới propagate được.

references.title: Creating an AWS Firewall Manager policy
references.section: Creating an AWS Firewall Manager policy for AWS WAF
references.quote: In a Firewall Manager AWS WAF policy, you can use managed rule groups, which AWS and AWS Marketplace sellers create and maintain for you.
references.supports: Firewall Manager WAF policy dùng được rule group của AWS Marketplace.

references.title: AWS Firewall Manager
references.quote: With Firewall Manager, you set up your protections just once and the service automatically applies them across your accounts and resources, even as you add new accounts and resources.
references.supports: Firewall Manager áp dụng tự động cho mọi account/resource kể cả mới thêm (least overhead).

references.title: Creating an AWS Firewall Manager policy
references.quote: To protect resources in multiple Regions (other than CloudFront distributions), you must create separate Firewall Manager policies for each Region.
references.supports: Hạn chế của C: mỗi Region một policy, không có scope 'all Regions' trong một policy.

references.title: Service control policies (SCPs)
references.quote: SCPs do not grant permissions to the IAM users and IAM roles in your organization. No permissions are granted by an SCP.
references.supports: SCP chỉ là guardrail quyền, không thể chèn rule group vào web ACL (bác B).

references.title: Introduction to AWS Security Hub CSPM
references.quote: Security Hub CSPM runs checks against security controls and generates control findings to help you assess your compliance against security best practices.
references.supports: Security Hub CSPM chỉ đánh giá/tạo finding, không áp cấu hình (bác D).

references.title: Managing stacks across accounts and Regions with StackSets
references.quote: CloudFormation StackSets extends the capability of stacks by allowing you to create, update, or delete stacks across multiple accounts and AWS Regions with a single operation.
references.supports: StackSets triển khai được đa account/Region nhưng chỉ quản lý tài nguyên trong stack (A khả thi nhưng tốn công).

references.title: Rule group management for AWS WAF policies
references.quote: If you don't have a subscription to AWS WAF marketplace rule groups in your member account, Firewall Manager can't propagate custom or managed rule groups to that account.
references.supports: Điều kiện tiên quyết: member account cần subscription Marketplace (áp dụng cho mọi phương án).

references.title: Using AWS WAF policies with Firewall Manager
references.quote: keep any web ACLs that are already associated with in-scope resources, and retrofit them for use by the policy.
references.supports: Firewall Manager có thể retrofit web ACL đang gắn với ALB, nên rule group được đưa vào MỌI web ACL của resource trong scope.
